test_title: PYST 39: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ? 

# : XFL :: KSY : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : XFL :: KSY : %

**Option 1) # = SAG, % = PXO**

**For # (SAG) to XFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a12e3bea23bd675255ae95d702a45e2487c5e27ce25c95711d9ad52318955ec.png] 

**For KSY to % (PXO)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb6532639c2fe18a298f779508ed307bbf82a28227a20baf8bd7918750215463.png] 

Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = SAG, % = PXD**

**For # (SAG) to XFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7075bea41f8b56bca469096185845777292c404e45c231514853b04860bedbe.png] 

**For KSY to % (PXD)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c3dfb20bc55d1590cb4057f935b21209fdb9fb619345c02a8d3400f24428289.png] 

Option 2 is correct.

**Option 3) # = SAG, % = PID**

**For # (SAG) to XFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da9e9ddda1eac8fb34c947caae913ed71d905a4ef91726e5c49b94886c23406d.png] 

**For KSY to % (PID)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02b22406ceb9055b7acc7f6b314fd1c504e00c565c2cd53e5fa31294a13569bb.png] 

Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = TAG, % = PXD**

**For # (TAG) to XFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3164747c5633f7864ecb7611c8b4c723dcdf581fb467af20cb2179d0be560aa.png] 

**For KSY to % (PXD)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a0cc9c518bcc7ad9f0e64846d733d0ebd9927501ca79dd849a3e8c14d749fc0.png] 

Option 4 is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
